questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : एक साझेदारी फर्म में नया साझेदार प्रवेश पर पूँजी की एक सहमत राशि नगद या वस्तु रूप में लाता है ।
कारण (R) : एक साझेदारी फर्म में नया साझेदार प्रवेश पर साझेदारी फर्म की परिसम्पत्तियों तथा लाभों में भाग लेने का अधिकार ग्रहण करता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): In a partnership firm, at the time of admission, the new partner brings in an agreed amount of capital either in cash or in kind.
Reason (R): In a partnership firm, at the time of admission, the new partner acquires the right to share the assets and the profits of the partnership firm.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason are correct. When a new partner is admitted into a partnership firm, they must bring in an agreed amount of capital, which allows them to acquire the right to share the firm's assets. Therefore, the reason provides the correct logical explanation for the assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सही हैं। एक नए साझेदार को फर्म की परिसम्पत्तियों में हिस्सा प्राप्त करने के लिए पूँजी लानी होती है, अतः कारण अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: मीशा लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 6,000, 8% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन ₹ 96 प्रति ऋणपत्र पर किया । 8% ऋणपत्र खाते में जमा होंगे :
questions.text_english: Misha Ltd. issued 6,000, 8% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at 96 per debenture. 8% Debentures Account will be credited by:
questions.solution: The Debentures Account is always credited with the nominal (face) value of the debentures issued, regardless of whether they are issued at par, premium, or discount. Therefore, six thousand debentures multiplied by one hundred rupees gives a total nominal value of six lakh rupees.

sub_questions.text: भीम, अर्जुन तथा नकुल एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 4:3:3 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से वे लाभों को बराबर-बराबर अनुपात में विभाजित करने पर सहमत हुए । लाभ विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन के कारण अर्जुन का अधिलाभ अथवा त्याग होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: Bhim, Arjun and Nakul were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:3. With effect from 1st April, 2023, they agreed to share profits equally. Due to change in the profit sharing ratio, Arjun's gain or sacrifice will be :
sub_questions.solution: Arjun's old share was three-tenths and his new share is one-third. Subtracting the new share from the old share gives a negative one-thirtieth, which indicates a gain. Therefore, Arjun gains one-thirtieth share.

sub_questions.text: नीरू तथा मीतू क्रमशः ₹ 2,00,000 तथा ₹ 1,50,000 की पूँजी के साथ एक फर्म में साझेदार हैं। 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त हुए वर्ष में यदि फर्म का अर्जित लाभ ₹ 17,500 है, तो 10% वार्षिक दर से उनकी पूँजी पर ब्याज होगा :

sub_questions.solution: The actual interest on capital at ten percent comes to twenty thousand for Neeru and fifteen thousand for Meetu, totaling thirty-five thousand. Since the available profit is only seventeen thousand five hundred, it will be distributed in the capital ratio of four to three, giving Neeru ten thousand and Meetu seven thousand five hundred.

questions.solution: Students are required to attempt either part (i) or part (ii). The solution for part (i) involves calculating the sacrificing or gaining ratio, and the solution for part (ii) involves distributing insufficient profits in the ratio of appropriation.

questions.text: मानस और रनवीर एक फर्म में साझेदार हैं, जिनके पूँजी शेष क्रमशः ₹ 1,20,000 तथा ₹ 80,000 हैं। संजू को फर्म के भावी लाभों में 1/5 भाग के लिए एक नए साझेदार के रूप में प्रवेश दिया गया । संजू अपनी पूँजी के रूप में ₹ 1,00,000 लाया। संजू के प्रवेश पर फर्म की ख्याति होगी :
questions.text_english: Manas and Ranvir are partners in a firm having capital balances of ₹ 1,20,000 and ₹ 80,000 respectively. Sanju is admitted as a new partner in the firm for 1/5th share in future profits. Sanju brought ₹ 1,00,000 as his capital. The goodwill of the firm on Sanju's admission will be:
questions.solution: Based on Sanju's capital contribution of one lakh rupees for a one-fifth share, the total capital of the new firm should be five lakh rupees. The combined actual capital of all three partners is three lakh rupees. Subtracting the actual total capital from the newly calculated capital gives a hidden goodwill of two lakh rupees.
questions.solution_hindi: संजू की पूँजी के आधार पर फर्म की कुल पूँजी पाँच लाख रुपये होनी चाहिए। तीनों साझेदारों की वास्तविक पूँजी तीन लाख रुपये है। अतः फर्म की छिपी हुई ख्याति दो लाख रुपये होगी।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : जब साझेदारी का विघटन होता है, तो न्यायालय का हस्तक्षेप नहीं होता ।
कारण (R) : साझेदारी का विघटन साझेदारों के बीच आपसी सहमति द्वारा होता है ।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The court does not intervene when dissolution of partnership takes place.
Reason (R): Dissolution of partnership takes place by mutual agreement between the partners.
Choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) ग़लत है ।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is incorrect, but Reason (R) is correct.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is incorrect.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and reason are true. The dissolution of a partnership refers to a change in the existing relationship between the partners by mutual agreement. Since it is a mutual understanding, the court does not need to intervene, making the reason a valid explanation for the assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं। साझेदारी का विघटन आपसी सहमति से होता है, इसलिए इसमें न्यायालय के हस्तक्षेप की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है।

questions.text: आशु तथा बासु साझेदार हैं तथा 2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते हैं। चेतन को एक नए साझेदार के रूप में 1/4 लाभ में भाग के लिए प्रवेश दिया गया जो उसने आशु तथा बासु से बराबर-बराबर अनुपात में प्राप्त किया । आशु, बासु तथा चेतन का नया लाभ विभाजन अनुपात होगा :
questions.text_english: Ashu and Basu are partners sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 2:1. Chetan is admitted as a new partner with 1/4th share in the profits which he acquires equally from Ashu and Basu. The new profit sharing ratio between Ashu, Basu and Chetan will be :
questions.solution: Chetan's share is one-fourth, which he acquires equally, meaning he takes one-eighth from Ashu and one-eighth from Basu. Ashu's new share is his old share of two-thirds minus one-eighth, yielding thirteen twenty-fourths. Basu's new share is one-third minus one-eighth, yielding five twenty-fourths. Chetan's share of one-fourth equals six twenty-fourths, creating a new ratio of thirteen to five to six.
questions.solution_hindi: चेतन 1/4 हिस्से के लिए प्रवेश करता है, जो वह आशु और बासु से समान रूप से (1/8 प्रत्येक से) प्राप्त करता है। आशु का नया हिस्सा 2/3 - 1/8 = 13/24 होगा, और बासु का नया हिस्सा 1/3 - 1/8 = 5/24 होगा। चेतन का हिस्सा 1/4 (या 6/24) है, जिससे नया अनुपात 13:5:6 हो जाता है।
questions.chapter: Accounting for Partnership Firms - Admission of a Partner

sub_questions.text: यदि ₹ 100 के एक अंश/शेयर का हरण (forfeit) कर लिया गया है जिस पर ₹ 70 का भुगतान किया जा चुका है, तो इसे कितने न्यूनतम मूल्य पर पुनः निर्गमित किया जा सकता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: If a share of ₹ 100 on which ₹ 70 has been paid is forfeited, then at which minimum price can it be re-issued ?
sub_questions.solution: The maximum discount that can be allowed on the reissue of forfeited shares is equal to the amount already forfeited on those shares. Since seventy rupees has been paid and forfeited, the minimum reissue price will be the face value minus the forfeited amount, which equals thirty rupees.

sub_questions.text: यदि ₹ 10 के एक अंश/शेयर का हरण (forfeit) कर लिया गया है जिसे ₹ 2 प्रति अंश/शेयर प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित किया गया था तथा जिस पर ₹ 8 (प्रीमियम सहित) माँगे गए थे तथा अंशधारी / शेयरधारी ने ₹ 6 (प्रीमियम सहित) का भुगतान कर दिया था, तो अंश/शेयर पूँजी खाता नाम होगा :
sub_questions.text_english: If a share of ₹ 10 issued at a premium of ₹ 2 per share, on which ₹ 8 (including premium) has been called and ₹ 6 (including premium) has been paid by the shareholder, is forfeited, then Share Capital Account will be debited with:
sub_questions.solution: Upon forfeiture, the Share Capital Account is debited exclusively with the called-up face value. Out of the eight rupees called up, two rupees account for the premium, which leaves six rupees as the called-up face value that must be debited.

questions.solution: The student must attempt one part regarding the forfeiture logic. Part (i) focuses on determining the minimum reissue price based on forfeited amounts, whereas part (ii) tests the amount to be debited to the share capital account during forfeiture, reflecting the called-up face value excluding the premium.

questions.text: 1 अप्रैल, 2022 को मेगा लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 30,000, 10% ऋणपत्रों का निर्गमन 10% बट्टे पर किया । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष में ऋणपत्रों पर देय ब्याज की कुल राशि होगी :

questions.solution: Interest on debentures is always calculated on their nominal face value, irrespective of issue prices like discounts or premiums. The total face value is thirty lakh rupees, and ten percent interest calculated on thirty lakhs equals three lakh rupees for the full year.
questions.solution_hindi: ऋणपत्रों पर ब्याज हमेशा उनके अंकित मूल्य पर निकाला जाता है, चाहे वे बट्टे पर ही क्यों न निर्गमित किए गए हों। 30,00,000 का 10% ब्याज तीन लाख रुपये होगा।

questions.text: एक फर्म के विघटन के समय कुल परिसम्पत्तियाँ ₹ 6,00,000 तथा बाह्य देयताएँ ₹ 2,40,000 थीं । यदि परिसम्पत्तियों से ₹ 7,20,000 की वसूली हुई तथा ₹ 8,000 के वसूली व्ययों का भुगतान किया गया, तो वसूली पर लाभ अथवा हानि होगी :
questions.text_english: At the time of dissolution of a firm, the total assets were ₹ 6,00,000 and outside liabilities were ₹ 2,40,000. If assets realised ₹ 7,20,000 and realisation expenses of ₹ 8,000 were paid, the profit or loss on realisation will be:
questions.solution: To determine the gain or loss on realization, we compare the amounts realized and paid with their book values. The assets gained one lakh twenty thousand upon realization. The liabilities were paid off at their book value resulting in no gain or loss, and the realization expenses caused an eight thousand loss. Subtracting eight thousand from one lakh twenty thousand gives a net realization profit of one lakh twelve thousand.
questions.solution_hindi: परिसम्पत्तियों की वसूली से 1,20,000 रुपये का लाभ हुआ और 8,000 रुपये के व्यय का भुगतान किया गया। इसलिए, वसूली पर कुल शुद्ध लाभ 1,12,000 रुपये होगा।

questions.solution: The number of debentures issued is calculated by dividing the total purchase consideration by the net issue price of one debenture. questions.solution: When specific dates for drawings are not provided, interest is calculated for an average period of six months. sub_questions.text_english: Kishore and Bimal are partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3. Nand is admitted as a new partner in the firm for 1/4th share in the profits. Kishore and Bimal decide to share profits and losses equally in the future. The sacrificing ratio of Kishore and Bimal will be:
sub_questions.solution: Nand's share is one-fourth, leaving three-fourths for the old partners. Kishore and Bimal share this remaining fraction equally, yielding new individual shares of three-eighths each. Subtracting their new shares from their respective old shares reveals that Kishore sacrificed eleven fifty-sixths and Bimal sacrificed three fifty-sixths, giving a sacrificing ratio of eleven to three.

If profit of the firm for the year ended 31st March, 2023 is ₹ 1,60,000, Raju will bear a deficiency of :
sub_questions.solution: Tina is entitled to one-fifth of the total firm profit, which calculates to thirty-two thousand rupees. Since her guaranteed minimum is forty thousand rupees, there is a shortfall of eight thousand rupees. As stipulated, this entire deficiency of eight thousand rupees must be exclusively borne by Raju.

sub_questions.text_english: Priti Ltd. purchased assets worth ₹ 5,40,000 and took over liabilities of ₹ 1,20,000 of Payal Ltd. for a purchase consideration of ₹ 5,28,000. Priti Ltd. paid half the amount by cheque and the balance was settled by issuing 10% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of 10%. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Priti Ltd.

key_points: Entry 1: Debit Assets, Credit Liabilities, Credit Payal Ltd. for purchase consideration, and record Goodwill.
Entry 2: Debit Payal Ltd., Credit Bank Account for the cash/cheque settlement.
Entry 3: Debit Payal Ltd., Credit 10% Debentures and Securities Premium Reserve.

sub_questions.solution: In the books of Priti Ltd, first record the acquisition by debiting Sundry Assets Account with five lakh forty thousand rupees and Goodwill Account as a balancing figure with one lakh eight thousand rupees. Correspondingly, credit Sundry Liabilities Account with one lakh twenty thousand rupees and Payal Ltd with five lakh twenty-eight thousand rupees. To record the half payment, debit Payal Ltd and credit Bank Account with two lakh sixty-four thousand rupees. For the balance, debit Payal Ltd with two lakh sixty-four thousand rupees, and credit ten percent Debentures Account with two lakh forty thousand rupees, and Securities Premium Reserve with twenty-four thousand rupees, accounting for the issue of twenty-four hundred debentures at a premium.

sub_questions.text: धातु लिमिटेड ने ₹ 100 प्रत्येक के 4,000, 11% ऋणपत्रों को ₹ 50 प्रति ऋणपत्र प्रीमियम पर निर्गमित करने के लिए आवेदन आमंत्रित किए । पूरी राशि का भुगतान आवेदन पर देय था । 5,000 ऋणपत्रों के लिए आवेदन प्राप्त हुए । 1,000 ऋणपत्रों के आवेदनों को रद्द कर दिया गया तथा आवेदन राशि वापस कर दी गई। शेष आवेदकों को ऋणपत्रों का आबंटन कर दिया गया । धातु लिमिटेड की पुस्तकों में उपर्युक्त लेनदेनों के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Dhatu Ltd. invited applications for issuing 4,000, 11% Debentures of ₹ 100 each at a premium of ₹ 50 per debenture. Full amount was payable on application. Applications were received for 5,000 debentures. Applications for 1,000 debentures were rejected and application money was refunded. Debentures were allotted to the remaining applicants. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Dhatu Ltd.

key_points: Entry 1: Receive application money for 5,000 debentures at ₹ 150 each.
Entry 2: Transfer application money to Debentures account and Securities Premium, and refund the excess application money.

sub_questions.solution: In the books of Dhatu Ltd, initially debit the Bank Account and credit the Debenture Application and Allotment Account with seven lakh fifty thousand rupees, representing the receipt of money for five thousand applications at one hundred fifty rupees each. Next, debit the Debenture Application and Allotment Account with seven lakh fifty thousand rupees, credit eleven percent Debentures Account with four lakh rupees representing the nominal value, credit Securities Premium Reserve with two lakh rupees for the premium collected, and credit the Bank Account with one lakh fifty thousand rupees to reflect the refunded amount to rejected applicants.

questions.text: सोहम, आशीष, विशेष तथा राशि एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 4:3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से उन्होंने लाभ-हानि का विभाजन 2:1:1:1 के अनुपात में करने का निर्णय लिया। उनका स्थिति विवरण ₹ 80,000 का सामान्य संचय दर्शा रहा था। फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 5,00,000 किया गया । लाभ विभाजन अनुपात में परिवर्तन के कारण उपर्युक्त के लिए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए । अपने कार्य को स्पष्टता से दर्शाइए ।
questions.text_english: Soham, Ashish, Vishesh and Rashi were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 4:3:2:1. With effect from 1st April, 2023, they decided to share profits and losses in the ratio of 2:1:1:1. Their Balance Sheet showed a General Reserve of ₹ 80,000. The goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 5,00,000. Pass necessary journal entries for the above on account of change in the profit sharing ratio. Show your working clearly.

key_points: Distribution of General Reserve in old ratio.
Calculation of sacrificing and gaining shares.
Adjustment entry for Goodwill through capital accounts.

questions.solution: First, distribute the existing general reserve by debiting the General Reserve Account with eighty thousand rupees and crediting the capital accounts of Soham, Ashish, Vishesh, and Rashi with thirty-two thousand, twenty-four thousand, sixteen thousand, and eight thousand rupees respectively based on their old ratio of four to three to two to one. Next, compute the gain or sacrifice: Rashi gains one-tenth share while Ashish sacrifices one-tenth. To adjust goodwill, debit Rashi's Capital Account with fifty thousand rupees, which is one-tenth of the five lakh goodwill, and correspondingly credit Ashish's Capital Account with fifty thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: प्रतीक, चारु तथा सिरिमा एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभों का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को प्रतीक फर्म से सेवानिवृत्त हो गया । चारु और सिरिमा ने निर्णय लिया कि नई फर्म की पूँजी ₹ 6,30,000 होगी । सेवानिवृत्ति की तिथि को चारु और सिरिमा के पूँजी खाते सभी समायोजनों के पश्चात् क्रमश: ₹ 4,35,000 तथा ₹ 1,89,000 का जमा शेष दर्शा रहे थे । साझेदारों द्वारा फर्म में लाई जाने वाली नगद की वास्तविक राशि अथवा उन्हें भुगतान की जाने वाली नगद राशि की गणना कीजिए । आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ भी कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Prateek, Charu and Sirima were partners in a firm sharing profits in the ratio of 3:2:1. Prateek retired from the firm on 31st March, 2023. Charu and Sirima decided that the capital of the new firm will be ₹ 6,30,000. The capital accounts of Charu and Sirima after all adjustments on the date of retirement showed a credit balance of ₹ 4,35,000 and ₹ 1,89,000 respectively. Calculate the amount of actual cash to be brought into the firm or to be paid to the partners. Also pass necessary journal entries.

key_points: Calculate new capital requirement based on the 2:1 new ratio.
Determine excess or deficit for Charu and Sirima.
Pass journal entry for cash paid out or brought in.

sub_questions.solution: Charu and Sirima will share future profits in the ratio of two to one. The new firm capital is set at six lakh thirty thousand rupees, meaning Charu's required capital is four lakh twenty thousand rupees, and Sirima's is two lakh ten thousand rupees. Charu has an existing balance of four lakh thirty-five thousand rupees, meaning she has an excess of fifteen thousand rupees which the firm will pay her. Sirima has an existing balance of one lakh eighty-nine thousand rupees, meaning she has a deficit of twenty-one thousand rupees which she must bring in. The required journal entry debits Bank and credits Sirima's Capital Account with twenty-one thousand rupees, and simultaneously debits Charu's Capital Account and credits Bank with fifteen thousand rupees.

sub_questions.text: चमन, बर्मन तथा अमन एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2:1 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । अमन को प्रति वर्ष उसके लाभ के भाग के रूप में न्यूनतम ₹ 60,000 की गारंटी दी गई थी । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष के लिए शुद्ध लाभ की राशि ₹ 1,20,000 थी । फर्म की पुस्तकों में साझेदारों के बीच लाभ-विभाजन दर्शाते हुए आवश्यक रोज़नामचा प्रविष्टियाँ कीजिए ।

Pass necessary journal entries in the books of the firm showing the distribution of profit amongst the partners.

Calculate normal shares and determine Aman's deficiency.
Allocate deficiency to Chaman and Burman in their 3:2 ratio.

sub_questions.solution: The total profit of one lakh twenty thousand rupees must be transferred by debiting Profit and Loss Account and crediting Profit and Loss Appropriation Account. Aman's normal one-sixth share equals twenty thousand rupees, creating a deficiency of forty thousand rupees to meet his guaranteed sixty thousand rupees. This deficiency is borne by Chaman and Burman in their mutual ratio of three to two, resulting in Chaman sacrificing twenty-four thousand and Burman sacrificing sixteen thousand. The final entry debits the Appropriation Account with one lakh twenty thousand rupees, credits Chaman with thirty-six thousand rupees, credits Burman with twenty-four thousand rupees, and credits Aman with his guaranteed sixty thousand rupees.

questions.text: 1 अप्रैल, 2023 को एक साझेदारी फर्म की पुस्तकें ₹ 5,00,000 की परिसम्पत्तियाँ दर्शा रही थीं, जिसमें ₹ 23,000 नगद तथा ₹ 27,000 का बैंक शेष सम्मिलित था। साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते ₹ 3,50,000 का शेष दर्शा रहे थे और बाकी की राशि का संचय था। यदि लाभ की सामान्य प्रतिफल दर 10% है तथा फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन अधिलाभों के 4 वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर ₹ 1,00,000 किया गया है, तो फर्म के औसत लाभों को ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: On 1st April, 2023, the books of a partnership firm showed assets of ₹ 5,00,000 including cash of ₹ 23,000 and bank balance of ₹ 27,000. The partners' capital accounts showed a balance of ₹ 3,50,000 and reserves constituted the rest. If the normal rate of return is 10% and the goodwill of the firm is valued at ₹ 1,00,000 at 4 years purchase of super profits, find the average profits of the firm.

key_points: Determine the capital employed.
Calculate super profits using the goodwill formula.
Calculate normal profits.
Determine average profits.

questions.solution: The firm's capital employed is structurally equal to the total assets, which amount to five lakh rupees. Normal profit is calculated at ten percent of this capital employed, giving fifty thousand rupees. Given the goodwill of one lakh rupees based on a four-year purchase, the super profit equals one lakh divided by four, which is twenty-five thousand rupees. Since super profit is average profit minus normal profit, we add the twenty-five thousand super profit to the fifty thousand normal profit, revealing the total average profit to be seventy-five thousand rupees.

RR Ltd. was registered with an authorised capital of ₹ 8,00,000 divided into 80,000 equity shares of ₹ 10 each. The company offered to the public for subscription 40,000 equity shares. The amount per share was payable as follows:
On Application ₹ 5
On Allotment ₹ 3
On first and final call Balance
The issue was fully subscribed and all amounts due were received except the allotment and call money on 2,000 shares allotted to Seema.
Present the Share Capital in the Balance Sheet of the company as per Schedule III, Part I of the Companies Act, 2013. Also prepare 'Notes to Accounts' for the same.

key_points: Format Balance Sheet extract showing Share Capital.
Prepare Notes to Accounts.
Detail Authorised, Issued, and Subscribed Capital.
Deduct Calls in Arrears to show Subscribed but not fully paid capital.

questions.solution: In the Balance Sheet extract of RR Ltd under 'Equity and Liabilities', the sub-head 'Share Capital' will display three lakh ninety thousand rupees associated with Note number one. The Notes to Accounts for Share Capital will present the Authorised Capital as eighty thousand equity shares of ten rupees each totaling eight lakh rupees. The Issued Capital is listed as forty thousand equity shares of ten rupees each totaling four lakh rupees. Under Subscribed Capital, the category 'Subscribed and fully paid-up' shows thirty-eight thousand shares at ten rupees each totaling three lakh eighty thousand rupees. The category 'Subscribed but not fully paid-up' details two thousand shares at ten rupees each yielding twenty thousand rupees, less calls in arrears of ten thousand rupees (two thousand shares failing five rupees each for allotment and call), leaving ten thousand rupees. The sum of these segments produces the final Share Capital figure of three lakh ninety thousand rupees.

अदिति, रेनू एवं वर्षा एक फर्म में साझेदार थीं तथा 3:2:5 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करती थीं। 31 मार्च, 2023 को उनका स्थिति विवरण दिया गया है। 31 जुलाई, 2023 को वर्षा की मृत्यु हो गई। किसी साझेदार की मृत्यु पर साझेदारी समझौते में निम्न का प्रावधान था :
(i) पूँजी पर ब्याज 6% वार्षिक दर से दिया जाएगा ।
(ii) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन पिछले पाँच वर्षों के औसत लाभों के 3 वर्षों के क्रय के आधार पर किया जाएगा, जो ₹ 90,000 थे ।
(iii) मृत्यु की तिथि तक लाभ अथवा हानि में वर्षा के भाग की गणना विक्रय के आधार पर की जाएगी। 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष का विक्रय ₹ 60,00,000 था तथा 1 अप्रैल, 2023 से 31 जुलाई, 2023 तक ₹ 15,00,000 था । 31 मार्च, 2023 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष का लाभ ₹ 12,00,000 था ।
वर्षा के उत्तराधिकारियों को प्रस्तुत करने के लिए वर्षा का पूँजी खाता तैयार कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
Aditi, Renu and Varsha were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2:5. Their Balance Sheet on 31st March, 2023 contained capital balances of Aditi (5,00,000), Renu (4,00,000), Varsha (3,00,000) and General Reserve (1,00,000). Varsha died on 31st July, 2023. The partnership deed provided for the following, on the death of a partner:
(i) Interest on capital was to be provided @ 6% p.a.
(ii) Goodwill of the firm was to be valued at 3 years purchase of average profits of the previous five years which were ₹ 90,000.
(iii) Varsha's share of profit or loss till the date of death was to be calculated on the basis of sales. Sales for the year ended 31st March, 2023 amounted to ₹ 60,00,000 and that from 1st April, 2023 to 31st July, 2023 amounted to ₹ 15,00,000. The profit for the year ended 31st March, 2023 was ₹ 12,00,000.
Prepare Varsha's Capital Account to be rendered to her executors.

key_points: Credit opening capital balance and General Reserve share.
Calculate and credit interest on capital for 4 months.
Calculate firm's goodwill and credit Varsha's share.
Calculate Varsha's share of profit based on sales up to death.
Transfer the final balance to Varsha's Executors Account.

questions.solution: Varsha's Capital Account begins with a credit balance of three lakh rupees. Her share in the General Reserve, which is half of one lakh, results in a credit of fifty thousand rupees. Interest on her capital for the four months from April to July at six percent per annum generates a credit of six thousand rupees. The firm's total goodwill is evaluated at two lakh seventy thousand rupees, making her half share equal to one lakh thirty-five thousand rupees, which is credited to her account and debited to Aditi and Renu in their gaining ratio of three to two. Finally, estimating profit based on sales proportionality, the firm's profit from April to July is three lakh rupees. Varsha's half share of this profit amounts to one lakh fifty thousand rupees and is credited through the Profit and Loss Suspense Account. The grand total of these credits equals six lakh forty-one thousand rupees, which represents the complete and final sum transferred to Varsha's Executors Account.

key_points: Record forfeiture considering unpaid premiums.
Record reissue with applicable discounts or premiums.
Transfer proportionate capital reserve.

sub_questions.solution: For Star Ltd, debit Share Capital with six lakh forty thousand rupees representing the called-up value, and debit Securities Premium with eighty thousand rupees because the premium was not received. Credit Forfeited Shares with one lakh sixty thousand rupees, representing the amount actually collected on application, and credit Calls in Arrears or the respective allotment and call accounts with five lakh sixty thousand rupees. Applications were received for 60,000 shares. Applications for 12,000 shares were rejected and money returned to the applicants. All shareholders paid the allotment money except one shareholder who had applied for 1,200 shares. His shares were forfeited immediately after allotment. First call was made thereafter and all the money due was received. The second and final call was not yet made. Pass necessary journal entries for the above transactions in the books of Zee Ltd.

key_points: Record application money received and pro-rata adjustments with refunds.
Calculate actual allotment money due, accounting for the excess adjusted.
Determine the defaulting shareholder's allotted shares and precise unpaid amount.
Pass forfeiture entry strictly based on called-up capital prior to the first call.
Make the first call and record its receipt on the remaining shares.

sub_questions.solution: Commence by recording the receipt of application money: debit Bank Account and credit Share Application Account with two lakh forty thousand rupees representing sixty thousand shares. Allocate this by debiting Share Application with two lakh forty thousand rupees, crediting Share Capital with one lakh sixty thousand rupees, crediting Share Allotment with thirty-two thousand rupees representing the pro-rata excess from forty-eight thousand applicants, and crediting Bank Account with forty-eight thousand rupees for rejected refunds. Due allotment stands at two lakh rupees. The defaulting shareholder, who applied for twelve hundred shares, was allotted one thousand shares. His total due on allotment is five thousand rupees, but eight hundred rupees was pre-adjusted from excess application money, leaving four thousand two hundred rupees as unpaid. Thus, record the receipt of allotment money by debiting Bank with one lakh sixty-three thousand eight hundred rupees and crediting Share Allotment with the same amount. Proceed to forfeiture by debiting Share Capital with seven thousand rupees representing the called-up value, debiting Securities Premium with two thousand rupees, crediting Share Forfeiture with four thousand eight hundred rupees representing money genuinely received, and crediting Share Allotment with four thousand two hundred rupees. Finally, make the first call by debiting Share First Call and crediting Share Capital with seventy-eight thousand rupees for the remaining thirty-nine thousand shares, and record its receipt completely through the Bank Account.

संजू तथा मंजू एक फर्म में साझेदार थे तथा 3:2 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि का विभाजन करते थे । 31 मार्च, 2023 को उनका स्थिति विवरण दिया गया है। 1 अप्रैल, 2023 को लाभों में 1/4 भाग के लिए निम्नलिखित शर्तों पर उदय को फर्म में प्रवेश दिया गया :

sub_questions.text_english:
Sanju and Manju were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 3:2. Their Balance Sheet on 31st March, 2023 contained capital balances of Sanju as follows: 
 On 1st April, 2023, Uday was admitted into the firm for 1/4th share in profits on the following terms:
(i) Furniture was to be depreciated by ₹ 6,000.
(ii) Investments were valued at ₹ 72,000.
(iii) Plant and Machinery was taken over by Sanju and Manju in their profit sharing ratio.
(iv) Uday will bring in proportionate capital and ₹ 10,000 as his share of goodwill premium in cash.
Prepare Revaluation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts.

key_points: Prepare Revaluation Account assessing the gain or loss.
Adjust old partners' capital for General Reserve, Revaluation profit, and Goodwill premium.
Deduct the value of assets taken over from their capital accounts.
Calculate the new partner's proportionate capital based on the adjusted combined capital.

sub_questions.solution: To prepare the Revaluation Account, credit the increase in investment value of twelve thousand rupees and debit the depreciation on furniture of six thousand rupees. This results in a net revaluation profit of six thousand rupees, which is credited to Sanju and Manju in their three to two ratio, yielding three thousand six hundred and two thousand four hundred respectively. Moving to the Partners' Capital Accounts, begin by crediting the opening balances of one lakh forty thousand for Sanju and one lakh twenty thousand for Manju. Credit the General Reserve in their old ratio, giving twenty-four thousand to Sanju and sixteen thousand to Manju. Credit the revaluation profit, and also credit Uday's goodwill premium of ten thousand rupees in their sacrificing ratio, providing six thousand to Sanju and four thousand to Manju. Debit Sanju's account with forty-eight thousand and Manju's with thirty-two thousand for the plant and machinery they took over. After these adjustments, Sanju's adjusted capital becomes one lakh twenty-five thousand six hundred and Manju's becomes one lakh ten thousand four hundred, totaling two lakh thirty-six thousand. This total represents the three-fourths share of the new firm. Therefore, Uday must bring in proportionate capital amounting to one-third of this combined adjusted capital, which equals seventy-eight thousand six hundred sixty-seven rupees. Uday's Capital Account is thus credited with this cash input.

(iii) फर्म की ख्याति का मूल्यांकन ₹ 1,60,000 किया गया ।
(iv) स्थायी सम्पत्तियों का मूल्य ₹ 5,000 अधिक पाया गया ।
(v) तनु तथा सारा के मध्य 2:3 के नए लाभ-विभाजन अनुपात पर सहमति हुई ।
(vi) रवि को देय राशि उसके ऋण खाते में हस्तान्तरित की जाएगी ।
रवि की सेवानिवृत्ति पर पुनर्मूल्यांकन खाता तथा साझेदारों के पूँजी खाते तैयार कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english:
Ravi, Tanu and Sara were partners in a firm sharing profits and losses in the ratio of 5:3:2. Ravi retired from the firm due to his illness on 31st March, 2023. The Balance Sheet of the firm on that date included as follows: 
(i) Creditors included a sum of ₹ 4,000 which was not likely to be claimed.
(ii) A provision of 5% for doubtful debts was to be created on debtors.
(iii) Goodwill of the firm was valued at ₹ 1,60,000.
(iv) Fixed Assets were found overvalued by ₹ 5,000.
(v) New profit sharing ratio of Tanu and Sara was agreed at 2:3.
(vi) The amount due to Ravi was transferred to his loan account.
Prepare Revaluation Account and Partners' Capital Accounts on Ravi's retirement.

key_points: Prepare Revaluation Account detailing asset reductions and creditor write-offs.
Distribute Revaluation loss, existing P&L balances, and calculate gaining ratios.
Adjust retiring partner's share of Goodwill.
Transfer retiring partner's final balance to their Loan Account.

sub_questions.solution: The Revaluation Account is prepared by debiting the five percent provision on debtors, which equals ten thousand rupees, and debiting the five thousand rupee overvaluation in fixed assets. Credit the unclaimable creditors amount of four thousand rupees. This results in a net revaluation loss of eleven thousand rupees, partitioned amongst Ravi, Tanu, and Sara as five thousand five hundred, three thousand three hundred, and two thousand two hundred respectively. In the Partners' Capital Accounts, commence by crediting opening balances. Apportion the existing Profit and Loss liability balance by crediting Ravi with eighty-five thousand, Tanu with fifty-one thousand, and Sara with thirty-four thousand. Ravi's half share of the firm's one lakh sixty thousand goodwill amounts to eighty thousand rupees. The gaining ratio is ascertained as Tanu gaining one-tenth and Sara gaining four-tenths. Thus, Ravi's goodwill is credited by debiting Tanu's capital with sixteen thousand and Sara's capital with sixty-four thousand rupees. After computing all credits and deducting the revaluation loss, Ravi's total outstanding balance reaches two lakh thirty-nine thousand five hundred rupees, which is firmly transferred to his newly established Loan Account.

questions.solution: Execute either the admission scenario by preparing the Revaluation and Capital Accounts including proportionate capital extraction, or the retirement scenario documenting revaluation losses, goodwill distributions through gaining ratios, and transferring the retired partner's dues to a loan account.

Classify the following items under major heads and sub-heads (if any) in the Balance Sheet of the company as per Schedule III, Part I of the Companies Act, 2013:
(i) Unclaimed dividend
(ii) Raw materials
(iii) Capital Work-in-Progress

Raw materials: Current Assets (Major), Inventories (Sub-head)

questions.solution: To deploy the specified conditional calculation, first purposefully select the target spreadsheet cell designated to display the finalized savings outcome. Subsequently, navigate directly to the dedicated Formulas tab located securely on the main ribbon and forcefully select the 'Logical' command group. From the cascading dropdown, select 'IF', which promptly initiates the structured Function Arguments dialogue box. Within the 'Logical_test' input parameter field, carefully enter the conditional formula dictating that Total Income minus Expenses is strictly greater than ten thousand. Assuming Income occupies cell A1 and Expenses occupy B1, the test formula resembles A1 minus B1 greater than ten thousand. In the consecutive 'Value_if_true' input field, mathematically insert the instruction generating ten percent savings. Conversely, within the final 'Value_if_false' parameter field, insert the alternative instruction calculating the diminished five percent savings rate. Execute the calculation by clicking 'OK'.
